svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Footing: dig a hole 600 x 600 x 750 deep, 1.2 m straight behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: kiln's centre. Ground sleeve: 730 mm of 101.6 x 3.6 tube with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm plate in its bottom end (a welder tacks it, or a bolt across

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tube holds a loose plate). Stand it 30 mm proud and plumb;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fill with concrete; wait at least three days.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post: 4.69 m of 88.9 x 3.2 tube; a 3 mm cap plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the top end. Two 17 mm holes across it: 20 mm and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 715 mm below the post's top end (CCB-DWG-116).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two people stand the post in the sleeve; it turns by hand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plumb both ways; the post turns freely through 90 degrees.
